'''Gizmal Gam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] who lived on the planet of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Gizmel lived in and owned a home in [[Oradam village]], and he was found attempting to find assistance in retrieving a shipment of supplies he lost which he planned to give a local village in order to gain their favor and to keep them from joining the Separatists. In truth however, his supplies were actually a shipment of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. Gizmal Gam met with several heroes who were on Ord Mantell at the time who may or may not have aided him in recovering his shipment.<ref name="Buying Loyalty" />

At some point during the [[Third Galactic War]], Gam began supplying the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] on behalf of an unidentified benefactor, whom he was unaware worked directly for [[Darth Krovos]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|A Favor or Two|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>
